250-779-1315-1479-7885.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-7885.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1315-1479-7885.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1386-2845-3556-3584.description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Meldweb Curator.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Flicker at least once, with each copy targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the first copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.

You may optionally target any permanent using the additional Flicker copies to blink them.
